questions.question: Quiz 1: When should the circuit breaker transition from Open to Half-Open?
options: Immediately after the first failure that opened it
After the configured recovery timeout has elapsed
When the upstream service sends a health-check ping
questions.explanation: After the configured recovery timeout has elapsed

questions.question: Quiz 2: Why add jitter to exponential backoff?
options: To make the delay longer on average
To desynchronize retries and prevent thundering herds
To reduce the total number of retry attempts
questions.explanation: To desynchronize retries and prevent thundering herds

questions.question: Quiz 3: What's the difference between rate limiting and concurrency limiting?
options: There is no difference; they are synonyms
Rate limiting caps requests over time; concurrency limiting caps simultaneous requests
Rate limiting is client-side; concurrency limiting is server-side
Concurrency limiting only applies to HTTP/2 streams
questions.explanation: Rate limiting caps requests over time; concurrency limiting caps simultaneous requests
